```yaml
name: Bump Personal Server After Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  bump-personal-server:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Hush Line
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Checkout Personal Server
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: scidsg/hushline-personal-server
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          path: hushline-personal-server

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install requests

      - name: Bump version in Personal Server
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
        run: |
          # Extract version from the release tag (remove 'v' prefix if present)
          RELEASE_VERSION="${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          CLEAN_VERSION="${RELEASE_VERSION#v}"
          
          echo "Bumping version to: ${CLEAN_VERSION}"
          
          # Update DEBIAN/control
          CONTROL_FILE="hushline-personal-server/DEBIAN/control"
          if [ -f "$CONTROL_FILE" ]; then
            sed -i "s/^Version: .*/Version: ${CLEAN_VERSION}/" "$CONTROL_FILE"
            echo "Updated $CONTROL_FILE"
          else
            echo "Warning: $CONTROL_FILE not found"
          fi
          
          # Update docker-compose.yaml
          COMPOSE_FILE="hushline-personal-server/var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml"
          if [ -f "$COMPOSE_FILE" ]; then
            # Replace image tag with the new version
            sed -i "s|image: ghcr.io/scidsg/hushline:.*|image: ghcr.io/scidsg/hushline:${CLEAN_VERSION}|" "$COMPOSE_FILE"
            echo "Updated $COMPOSE_FILE"
          else
            echo "Warning: $COMPOSE_FILE not found"
          fi

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          path: hushline-personal-server
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          commit-message: "Bump version to ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          title: "Bump version to ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          body: |
            Automated version bump following Hush Line release ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}.
            
            This PR updates:
            - `DEBIAN/control` version
            - `var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml` image tag
          branch: "bump-version/${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          delete-branch: true
          base: main
          labels: |
            automated
            version-bump

      - name: Merge Pull Request
        if: success()
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
        run: |
          # Wait a moment for the PR to be fully created
          sleep 5
          
          # Find the PR number
          PR_NUMBER=$(gh pr list --search "Bump version to ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}" --json number --jq '.[0].number')
          
          if [ -n "$PR_NUMBER" ]; then
            echo "Found PR #${PR_NUMBER}, merging..."
            gh pr merge "${PR_NUMBER}" --auto --delete-branch
          else
            echo "No PR found to merge"
          fi
```
